observations.body: The signed-out Login page shows Username and Password fields, a Sign in button, and demo account labels including emily.dawson as Employee.
The Login form is displayed with the configured Employee username available and empty credentials ready for entry.
Signing in as emily.dawson reached the authenticated Dashboard showing Emily Dawson and Employee navigation.
Dashboard shows Employee navigation to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, and My Profile; quick links to Request leave and Fill timesheet; plus Notifications and Log out.

New leave request offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal leave types; required Start date and End date fields; an optional Reason field; Submit request and Cancel. It states weekends are not counted toward leave.
The New leave request form is open with Vacation selected and no dates entered; a single evaluation-data request will use 2026-10-05 through 2026-10-06.
The visible date textboxes were readonly; submitting with only the evaluation-data Reason displayed "Please fill in all required fields." and stayed on New leave request.
Clicking Start date opens an inline September 2026 calendar with previous and next month controls and day numbers.
Timesheet shows a draft for the week of Sep 14, 2026 with seven daily hour inputs at 0, total 0 h, and Save draft and Submit week actions.
My profile offers Upload photo, editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields, a disabled Email field, and Save changes. Personal values were not recorded.

Employee directory loaded 28 employees in a paginated table with Name, Department, Title, and Email columns; it offers name search, department filter, name sorting, and Next/Previous pagination. Personal row values were not recorded.
